name: HarfBuzzFix
description: Linux-only: patches gui's own NativeLibraryLoader.Register() (via Harmony) to load the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library with RTLD_DEEPBIND isolation instead of gui's default loader, preventing symbol interposition against an already-loaded system libharfbuzz (which otherwise corrupts the heap and aborts on hb_font_create). No-op if gui isn't installed or on non-Linux systems.
